proofs:threadsync.note: threadsync is 0.15.2-only (examples/threadsync/zig-versions): it exercises std.Thread.Mutex, Thread.Condition and Thread.WaitGroup, which 0.16.0 removed and 0.17.1 does not have; the Io primitives that replace them are covered by sync. model-boundary.note: lib/std/Io.zig 0.17.0->0.17.1: Event.waitTimeout loops to the deadline instead of returning Timeout on a spurious wakeup, and failingFileWritePositional rejects a non-empty header; both are translated std code (no model row covers them); Io.futexWaitTimeout and Io.Clock.now keep their timed model (STD-10). Memory.lean/StdModels.lean/std-models.md changed by the version rename (rows keyed 0.17.1 instead of 0.17.0) and, since PR #802, by the reviewed 0.17.1 hashes of Io.zig, os/linux.zig and c.zig (the rows had carried 0.17.0's hashes under 0.17.1; os/linux.zig and c.zig differ only in declarations no row names, docs/std-models.md section Zig 0.17.1 audit); model recognition unchanged. sync and lists translations and differential tests pass on 0.17.1.

evidence:tags.note: The AIR universes (tags, intern keys, types, pointer bases) are identical between 0.17.0 and 0.17.1 (plan impact.universes). Every tag row changed only because its evidence paths moved from 0.17.0 to 0.17.1 keys. The evidence behind them is fresh: every committed 0.17.1 AIR file is a patched-0.17.1 export pinned by exports.lock.json (scripts/fixture-exports.py), differing from 0.17.0 only by generic-instance renumbering, except shr_exact, which 0.17.1 emits only without runtime safety (runtime_tags.shrExact is safety-off). Goldens, translations and differential tests pass on aarch64-macos (16 examples + floatops) and x86_64-linux.

compiler-sources.note: Release diff of Io.zig, InternPool.zig, Sema.zig, Type.zig, codegen/llvm.zig (and lib/compiler_rt) reviewed in docs/zig-0.17-delta.md section 0.17.0 -> 0.17.1: Sema.zirShr emits shr (not shr_exact) under safety; compiler_rt fma.zig fixes modelled version-keyed (Float.fmaRt017, checked against fma.zig's own tests); vector abiSize on ARM-capped alignment is rejected by checkMemTy on every version; other Sema/InternPool/llvm changes are bug fixes with no new AIR form or native-only.
